name: Slide Bars
description: Four horizontal strips of the second clip slide in from alternating sides with motion blur, then the picture shakes and ripples as a ring flare bursts out. Recreation of the CapCut "Slide Bars" transition. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: duration
params.description: Real transition length in seconds; sets the speed of the shake
